summary: Mealie is a self-hosted recipe manager styled with Material design that lets you organise meals using categories and tags. It includes built-in tools for generating shopping lists, planning weekly menus, and customising site appearance while aiming to remain accessible for non-technical household members.
goodFor: It suits households looking to centralise their culinary collection, coordinate grocery shopping, and plan meals on a private server.
watchOut: You may find that maintaining shared access across multiple family members requires some initial user management and device configuration.
deployNotes: As a Python-based application, it typically requires persistent storage for uploaded recipes and images, along with a reverse proxy to handle TLS termination.
